notes.title: Enjoy a brand-new look into Motel Simulator 👀
notes.content:
[h1]Hey, aspiring motel managers👫[/h1]

It’s been a while since the last time we shared some news regarding the development of Motel Simulator. But worry no more – today we’re finally able to unveil the brand-new trailer for the game – How cool is that? The trailer gives you a sneak peek into the latest features, gameplay enhancements, and what you can expect in the near future. So, let’s not waste any more time, and jump straight into the bustling world of Motel Simulator 🏨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993818/260d93b138e143e59e313687fa5176a1574250b3.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Trailer 📷[/h2]

The moment you’ve been waiting for is here! The new trailer for Motel Simulator is live now. It showcases the dynamic and immersive experience of managing your own roadside motel. From renovating rooms to handling bookings, ensuring guest satisfaction, and more! Combine those elements with a universe teeming with the different needs of your one-of-a-kind clientele, and you’ve got a unique mixture that you should not miss. Check it for yourself 👇

[previewyoutube=itI8hUmjn5w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What’s Next? 🤔 [/h2]

While the trailer is the main highlight, we’re also working on several new updates to enhance your gameplay experience. Our team is busy as popcorn on a skillet to bring you the best possible gameplay experience and we cannot wait to see your ideas and suggestions regarding our brand-new title. 

Thank you for your ongoing support and enthusiasm. We can’t wait for you to see all the exciting things we have in store. Head over to the Steam page to learn more about the Motel Simulator. Last but not least, if you want to stay up-to-date with any news regarding the game, make sure to add it to your wishlist🙇Until the next devlog!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1792100/Motel_Simulator/

[i]~Sewek[/i]

notes.title: Bonuses & Penalties
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993818/236588feb0b351c7849b1ca37f3f50212f9efee9.jpg[/img]

There is a very interesting DevLog regarding the Gas Station Universe that takes a look at bonuses and penalties that will apply across all games and how they will influence your motel:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1149620/view/3721705159474906459


It even goes so far as stealing stuff at the gas station making visitors not feel that safe anymore and lowering their chance to staying at your motel. As a general rule, our design guidelines for bonuses and penalties are to follow the 3:1 rule, meaning for every 3 bonuses we implement 1 penalty. 

As these systems and their influence across Motel Simulator, Road Diner and Gas Station Simulator continue to grow, we will make some of them optional. Especially with the introduction of penalties we decided that is the way to go.

Now click on the link above and read more about. And when you are done reading about what the future holds, have a look at the present: we released 2 updates for the Airstrip DLC and another hotfix yesterday so go and check that out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137370/Gas_Station_Simulator__Airstrip_DLC/

notes.title: Food is going to be important
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993818/b1a82b23a2408eb45cea1b93864da74de97ca3f2.jpg[/img]

Food can be quite important when you run a motel and Motel Simulator will be using a very similar approach in that area to our Road Diner Simulator. The team working on it has just posted a bit of information about, so have a look:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1747470/view/3603473055466103994

Road Diner and Motel will share some mechanics when it comes to creating dishes at your Motel and they will also support each other. If you will have both games, the Road Diner will actually allow you cover most if not all of the early needs when it comes to food at your Motel allowing you to focus on other areas if you want to take a different approach in building up your business.

notes.title: DevLog #2: Early Customers and their Trucks
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993818/8f8f92516d43220965b329a4e4452ae9bc17cc26.jpg[/img]

In Motel Simulator you will encounter a huge amount of guests and customers of many types with different expectations, spending habits and general attitude, but there is one group that stands out and will be of special significance to you: truckers.

Getting your motel up and running won’t happen overnight. It takes time and a lot of money. And that money needs to be earned somehow. One of the ways is to focus on infrastructure that is of importance to truckers. Instead of investing all your money on rooms, it might be smarter to invest into things trackers want, first.

The thing with truckers is: a motel room is not always a priority. More often than not, they are more interested in space to park on and to sleep in their truck. So while rooms are not a primary consideration here, everything else is. While the truckers can spend the night in the bunk of their massive trucks, they still need quite a bit of infrastructure. Toilets, showers, hearty meals and at some point even entertainment sprint immediately to mind. Those will be the things drawing them to your motel early on, way before any other type of guests will take a real interest in your business. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993818/666c759d4309edf02bcc68fedafb0433ac74ef26.jpg[/img]

This in turn means trucks and their drivers will play a special role in Motel Simulator and allow you a different approach early on when it comes to how to set up and expand your motel. There will be other avenues you can pursue, but figured out we start with this one first as it’s quite interesting.

If you will own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149620/Gas_Station_Simulator/]Gas Station Simulator[/url] as well and have a higher level gas station built up, things will even get more interesting. Since Motel Simulator, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747470/Road_Diner_Simulator/]Road Diner Simulator[/url] and Gas Station Simulator work together despite being separate games, a decent gas station will be considered a large bonus for truckers in their decision making when it comes to spending the night at your place. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993818/fdc6c206390aa50418f47202b0acb2c8e2b04a52.jpg[/img]

Basically, if you set things up right, you won’t have to worry much about getting customers, just take care of building the things they need. And even that might become a bit easier if you also played Road Diner Simulator and have a decent diner set up there. You could skip on a lot of the early food services early, because a lot of the truckers and traveling sales men will be just fine eating there allowing you to shift your focus early on even more.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149620/Gas_Station_Simulator

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747470/Road_Diner_Simulator/

notes.title: DevLog #1: Gas Stations & Diners
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993818/38da3cdcf7aad749c76396db23799d6225a1e20f.jpg[/img]

Motel Simulator’s first DevLog was supposed to be about trucks and the customers associated with them, but in the last moment things have changed. The folks here that are working on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747470/Road_Diner_Simulator/]Road Diner Simulator[/url] just wrote a DevLog about how their game will work with both [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149620/Gas_Station_Simulator/]Gas Station Simulator[/url] and our Motel Simulator so we decided it makes a lot more sense to ask you to have a look at their DevLog instead:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1747470/view/3421064519334202740

The reason is simple: Road Diner Simulator and Motel Simulator are both based in the game world of our Gas Station Simulator and they will work together. You don’t have to own all 3 games, but if you have any 2 of them, you will see certain synergies. And that’s what that DevLog is all about: how those games will play nice together, what benefits they will receive and provide and how that’s a different approach than just make 3 separate games that are set in the same “universe”. Certainly worth a read for any future Motel Simulator gamer!

Our previously planned DevLog about trucks and truckers is going to posted next.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1149620/Gas_Station_Simulator/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1747470/Road_Diner_Simulator/

notes.title: Announcing Gas Station Simulator’s first DLC
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41993818/edd5d7aa0d81b860027b43786479d24c6e6bb970.jpg[/img]

A lot is happening in and around Gas Station Simulator. With the announcements of Road Diner Simulator and recently Motel Simulator, we set the wheels in motion for new games set in the Gas Station “universe”. 

Things are happening for Gas Station Simulator itself as well. Today we are announcing the first DLC for the Gas Station Simulator: Can Touch This. This DLC will introduce far reaching customization options for your gas station, workshop and warehouse.

From customizing walls and roofs up to changing position of windows, doors, trashcans or cash register, the DLC offers many new things that might catch your eye.
Stickers that you can spray anywhere on your gas station, more interior & exterior decorations and also more levels and employees!

Can Touch This is coming on 11th of May 2022 and will be priced at $2,99! Add it to your wishlist now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940030/Gas_Station_Simulator__Can_Touch_This_DLC/?beta=0
